title: Earthy Smoky Uruguayan Date Empanadas
description: Charred and fluffy empanadas filled with stoned dates and infused with kombu cold extract, wrapped in ti leaves for a cozy Uruguayan dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Make the kombu cold extract by soaking the kombu sheets in 2 cups of water for at least 4 hours.
Strain the kombu extract and discard the solids.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out 12 circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a stoned date in the center of each dough circle.
Drizzle a small amount of olive oil and kombu extract over each date.
Sprinkle smoked paprika and sea salt over the dates.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Wrap each empanada in a ti leaf, securing with a toothpick if necessary.
Bake the empanadas for 20 minutes, or until the ti leaves are charred and the dough is golden brown.
